setup: HP 3478A on NORMAL IN, supply unplugged, OUT open; divider INJECT on the range shown

usb_disconnect_test.method: 2-wire ohms, 30 MOhm range, 40 readings after 30 s; divider USB unplugged with the latching relays holding the state
